verses.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁਂ ਬੇਦਾਂ ਕੇ ਧਰਮ ਮਥਿ ਖਟਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਥਿ ਰਿਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: chahu(n) bedhaa(n) ke dharam math khaT saasatr kath rikh sunaavai|

en.bdb: Having churned the duties enjoined in the four Vedas, the seers have delineated the six Shastras.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਹਿ ਕਹਾ ਤਿਵੈ ਜਗੁ ਗਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: brahamaadhik sanakaadhikaa jiau teh kahaa tivai jag gaavai|

en.bdb: What ever was described by Brahma and Sanak, people recited and followed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਪੜਨਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gaavan paRan bichaar bahu koT madhe viralaa gat paavai|

en.bdb: Many think over while reading and singing, but only one among millions understands and reads between the lines.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹਿ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਮਨ ਆਵਦੀ ਪੜਤਿ ਗੁਣਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: eeh acharaj man aavadhee paRat gunat kachh bhedh na paavai|

en.bdb: Many think over while reading and singing, but only one among millions understands and reads between the lines.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗ ਇਕੋ ਵਰਨ ਹੈ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਕਿਉ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਦਿਖਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: jug jug iko varan hai kalijug kiau bahute dhikhalaavai|

en.bdb: It is surprising that every age had dominance of one colour (caste) but how in Kaliyug myriads of castes are there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੰਦ੍ਰੇ ਵਜੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਕਥਿ ਪੜ੍ਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: ja(n)dhre vaje tirahu jugee kath paReh rahai bharam neh jaavai|

en.bdb: That the duties of all the three Yugas have been abandoned is known to everybody but the confusion persists.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਥਿਆ ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦਿ ਖਟਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਖ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: jiau kar kathiaa chaar bedh khaT saasatr sa(n)g saakh sunaavai|

en.bdb: As the four Vedas have been defined, the description of the six philosophies (Shastras) also complements them.
They all eulogise their own view point.
